Shrinking of the Core (Debreu–Scarf)

Replicating the economy creates new coalitions that slice the core down. Watch the core interval shrink to the single competitive point across N=1,2,4,8N = 1, 2, 4, 8N=1,2,4,8 replicas — in a large economy, core and competitive equilibrium coincide.

core(N)↓{x∗}(N→∞)\text{core}(N) \downarrow \{x^*\} \quad (N \to \infty)core(N)↓{x∗}(N→∞)

Part of these learning paths

  • General Equilibrium and Welfare
